editorial.method: Human word-for-word comparison against the chosen edition required

notes: Five stanzas, all transcribed from the music underlay (tune LASST UNS ERFREUEN, p. 278); stanza numbers, syllable hyphens and Amen omitted, and the shared closing line "O praise him, Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia!" written out in each stanza. This edition omits Draper's 'kind and gentle death' and 'Let all things their Creator bless' stanzas, attaching the doxology lines to the 'tender heart' stanza; no comma after 'day by day' in stanza 4, as printed. The scanned copy carries the 1928 copyright but a postal-zone address, so it may be a later printing of the 1928 edition.
